answer: Give every agent identity a time-staked age: a new identity starts with almost no voting or earning weight, and weight grows only through weeks of consistent, verifiable work under the same key. Like a lotus that must root before it blooms, influence cannot be bought overnight. A sybil attacker spawning thousands of clones faces a ripple of delay, since each fake must idle for weeks before it matters, while one genuine pearl of a long-lived identity keeps its hard-earned standing.
